subject.title: [Feature]: Sidebar lobster pet occasionally fills in for the brand logo

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally allow the animated sidebar pet to replace the stable Control UI brand mark on rare page loads?
rationale: The implementation boundary is small and clear, but changing the stable brand anchor is a deliberate product and visual-identity choice that automation cannot approve.

options.title: Sponsor the rare takeover
options.body: Approve the focused, existing-setting-gated event with the proposed exclusivity, status-recall, and reduced-motion rules.

options.title: Keep the logo permanent
options.body: Treat the brand mark as a stable anchor and keep all pet visits on the footer ledge.

options.title: Defer the delight work
options.body: Keep the idea open but unscheduled behind the current security, stability, and setup priorities.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the rare takeover
recommendation.body: Approve the focused, existing-setting-gated event with the proposed exclusivity, status-recall, and reduced-motion rules.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently extended the pet behavior and authored the proposed interaction design.
